log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY: All kills are quick entries in the afternoon. Day workers get ruled out, which leaves a routine pool of 55%. Each of my 5 non-national place kinds is one place: R=East, S=blotter(20%), A=radio, F=forum, X=foreign. L cannot reach exactly 2 kinds. If L learns 3 of my kinds, the pool drops below 1000 and I am caught. If he learns 2, the pool is about 2750-3400, which is safe. GOAL: find the 2 unreachable kinds. Then kill every day from those 2 kinds, plus 2 of the 3 reachable kinds, plus national (about 9 per day, so x4 multiplier from about day 5). Never kill from the 3rd reachable kind (or at most 2 total traced, maybe near the end). PROBING: with 5 or fewer deaths in a day, all are traced. The daily increase in deaths_traced counts successful non-national traces. A success definitely proves that kind is reachable. A failure is weak evidence, because about 12% of victims fail when an extra unseen place is unreachable. Once 3 kinds are proven reachable, the other 2 are certainly unreachable. DAY 1: killed d1-2 (F, x1), d1-1 and d1-11 (X, x2), d1-6 national. 4 deaths, all traced. traced_before=0. Reading the day 1 increase: 3 means F and X are both reachable. 2 means X is reachable and F is unknown (about 73% F unreachable). 1 means one of them is reachable, unclear which. 0 means F and X are probably unreachable, so R, A and S are reachable. DAY 2 PLAN: probe R x1 and A x2 (+national) the same way, adapting to the day 1 result. Then S is inferred, since exactly 2 are unreachable. Confirm with extra probes if ambiguous. Start full mode once confident. Keep watching the traced increases and pool in full mode. The expected pool after L learns 1 kind is about 13750, after 2 kinds about 2750-3437.

Pick the 2 reachable kinds whose learned pool is larger: avoid S if possible (pool with S is 2750, without S it is 3437). Keep watching the pool: if it drops to about 3000 after 2 kinds are learned, never add a 3rd.
